baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three forms of belief and the completed taking of your covenant.
baseline_models.mechanism: The heart-security of faith mirrors reliance within W-TH-Q, while taking and the confirmed covenant make the bond already held rather than merely offered. The final believer-label tests whether claimed identity has become settled trust.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settled security supplies the inward condition repeatedly demanded by belief.
Certification that reassures the heart makes belief verified reliance rather than a bare label.
Taking and holding supplies the completed acquisition of the bond.
Reliance on what is dependable echoes the security branch of faith.
A confirmed compact supplies the objective bond in which inward trust should settle.

changed_reading.before: A request to assent because a covenant exists.
changed_reading.after: A rebuke for withholding settled, verified trust from a bond already taken and secured.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The messenger calls you to believe in your Lord, immediately beside your covenant.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship carries both gradual formation and a covenantal bond; the messenger's carried address verbally inclines the hearers back into that formative relation.

activation_trace.role: Repairing, raising, and completing makes your Lord an ongoing formative relation.
The root's covenantal bond links your Lord to the adjacent confirmed compact.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the means of return.
The carried saying and its bearer identify the caller as transmitted address.

changed_reading.before: The messenger asks hearers to assent to the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The messenger recalls them into the Lord's ongoing formative and covenantal care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding imperative pairs belief with expenditure from what people were made successors over. Succession denies final ownership, so outgoing wealth becomes an observable discharge of covenantal trust.

activation_trace.role: The confirmed compact anchors stewardship back in the focus ayah.
Money going out turns professed trust into release of held resources.
One succeeding and standing in another's place recasts possession as temporary custody.

structural_cues: 57:7 immediately precedes the focus and repeats belief around spending and succession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, paired imperatives, outgoing wealth, and succession; I infer that held resources function as entrusted covenant goods, while spending may alternatively be only one consequence of belief.

changed_reading.before: Failure to believe is failure to assent despite a covenant.
changed_reading.after: Failure to believe is exposed as withholding what a successor only holds in trust; covenanted confidence must spend.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah gives the revelatory process an outward direction and illuminated destination, then qualifies it with tenderness. The messenger's call is therefore more than verbal demand: it participates in a compassionate extraction.

activation_trace.role: Verbal calling anchors the extraction process in the focus construction.
Passing to the outside supplies the directional result of the call.
Illumination supplies the visible destination of that exit.
Tender compassion qualifies the movement as care rather than mere pressure.

structural_cues: 57:9 immediately follows and states a purpose: clear signs bring you out from plural darknesses to singular light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the call, an explicit exit into light, and tenderness; I assign the call a role in initiating that exit, while the live alternative is that the signs alone are its proximate instrument.

changed_reading.before: The messenger verbally asks for assent.
changed_reading.after: The messenger's call opens a compassionate route out of obscurity into visible orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus says a covenant has already been taken; later, no ransom is taken. The repeated taking creates a temporal asymmetry between a present bond to inhabit and a future substitute that cannot be accepted.

activation_trace.role: Completed taking makes the covenant the already-held object.
The confirmed compact identifies what is available for present fidelity.
Negated later taking echoes the focus verb while reversing its availability.
Putting one thing in place of another supplies the refused substitute.

structural_cues: The completed focus clause has taken contrasts with 57:15's today and passive no ransom is taken.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completed covenant-taking and later negated ransom-taking; I infer that covenantal response cannot be bought out later, though the shared verb may alternatively be only a generic lexical echo.

changed_reading.before: The prior covenant is evidence supporting belief.
changed_reading.after: The prior covenant is the timely bond with no deferred equivalent: what can be answered now cannot later be replaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith's heart-settlement is placed against a heart that should lower but becomes hard when the interval lengthens. Delay is thus not neutral: it changes the receiving organ addressed by the messenger.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settled security anchors the model in the focus's repeated belief.
Lowering and submission supplies the receptive movement expected of the heart.
The heart is the shared substrate of expected humility and ensuing hardness.
Lengthened time supplies the duration over which receptivity deteriorates.
A far endpoint gives delay its extended horizon.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies the consequence of prolonged nonresponse.

structural_cues: 57:16 renews the focus's interrogative pressure and contrasts humility and hardness on the same heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-humility, a lengthened interval, and resulting hardness; I infer that refusing the present call progressively impairs reception, while 57:16 may alternatively diagnose a later audience rather than the focus mechanism itself.

changed_reading.before: Nonbelief is a static failure of judgment.
changed_reading.after: Nonresponse is a timed process: postponing the call can harden the very heart that must settle into trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later messenger sequence moves through measure into people rising for justice and then iron. This gives the focus call a social and material telos: belief should stand up as ordered public equity, not remain private conviction.

activation_trace.role: The messenger's verbal inclination anchors the public sequence in the focus call.
Repeated carriers and carried messages place the call within an enduring messenger institution.
A balance of justice supplies the normative measure of collective life.
Resolute rising to an affair turns reception into public agency.
Equity and fairness name the order that people are to establish.
Iron's resistant solidity gives the just order a material capacity, not only an idea.

structural_cues: 57:25 sequences messengers, proofs, book, measure, people standing in justice, and iron.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies that sequence; I infer it as a telos of the focus messenger's call, while the alternative is that it describes the collective mission broadly rather than every act of faith.

changed_reading.before: The call seeks inward belief in God.
changed_reading.after: The call seeks a trust that rises into measured public justice with material means to sustain it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later failure is described as not tending a practice according to its due. The focus covenant therefore becomes a living charge requiring preservation and observance, not a completed credential one merely possesses.

activation_trace.role: The confirmed compact supplies the focus charge that requires ongoing care.
Preserving and tending a covenant supplies the maintenance action missing from a merely historical bond.
A fixed due and binding obligation supplies the standard of adequate tending.

structural_cues: 57:27 places failure to tend something according to its due immediately before distinguishing those who believed from many who defected.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covenant, later tending, and due measure; I infer the later failure as a negative model for 57:8's belief, while its immediate object may alternatively be too specific to generalize to this covenant.

changed_reading.before: The taken covenant is past evidence that should induce belief.
changed_reading.after: The taken covenant is a present charge whose truth appears only when it is continuously tended according to its due.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those already designated believers are commanded to believe again in the messenger; the result is doubled carried shares and light used for walking. The focus's three belief forms can therefore mark renewable response that becomes navigational capacity.

activation_trace.role: Repeated certification anchors the possibility that belief is renewed rather than mentioned redundantly.
Believers commanded again to certify supplies an iterative structure of allegiance.
A carried share or prepared counterpart supplies the doubled consequence of renewed response.
Illumination turns renewed belief into practical orientation.
Walking and movement make that orientation usable through ongoing action.

structural_cues: 57:28 addresses those who believed, commands belief in the messenger, and connects the result to light by which they walk.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated belief and consequent share, light, and walking; I infer that the focus repetition marks renewable allegiance, while distinct stages or objects of belief remain a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Belief is a binary status one either has or lacks.
changed_reading.after: Belief is renewable allegiance: an already-believing identity must answer the messenger again and become walking light.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The milk-starter image for calling and the nourishment image for lordship are form-distant, but both are packet branches anchored to the focus words; render this only as an exploratory material analogy, never as their lexical translation here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The messenger calls you to believe in your Lord.

activation_trace.role: Milk deliberately retained to draw what follows supplies a starter-and-release image for the call.
Nourishment and growth supply the latent development occurring under your Lord.

changed_reading.before: The call deposits belief from outside.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the call acts like a retained starter that draws out faith latent within the Lord's nurturing relation.

strongest_changes: Completed covenant-taking now stands opposite the later refusal to take ransom: present trust has no deferred substitute.
The messenger's call expands from verbal persuasion into compassionate extraction and public standing by measure and justice.
The covenant becomes a charge sustained through spending, timely heart-response, tending, and renewed walking belief.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated belief and taking created the strongest cross-context links; the exact trust overlap between A-M-N and W-TH-Q, R-B-B's nurture/covenant branches, and R-AY's covenant-tending kept the readings focus-anchored while allowing a material milk-starter outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The covenant/ransom contrast may be an intentional temporal reversal or only a shared generic taking verb.
The failed tending in 57:27 may be too specific in its immediate object to generalize fully to the focus covenant.
The milk-starter reading is a branch-supported analogy, not a proposed contextual sense.
